actions.action: Move plant within about 1 m of brightest window, avoiding hot afternoon sun
Lift nursery pot out of cover pot and tip out standing water
Check soil moisture 5 cm deep and squeeze stem at soil level
If soil is dry, water slowly until it drains from the bottom
If stem base is soft/black or soil smells sour, unpot and post a photo of the roots
Empty the cover pot 15 minutes after each watering

reason: The answer correctly flags low light but misses the repotting and staking/support needs, so its advice covers only part of the fix, though nothing it suggests is harmful.
